value.rationale: Natural complete arithmetic-progressions classification of noncyclic squarefree semiprime group orders, including explicit positive leading constants, sharp p-adic local obstructions and finite support cutoff in forbidden classes. Provides rigorously scoped structural context for the progression-equidistribution question posed by Cohen without pretending to settle it for all cyclic numbers.
